1)       Consideration to Purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Musco Sports
                Lighting, LLC, for the purchase of a Mobile Video Trailer for the Community
                Recreation and Events Department. (2023-2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund, 2021
                Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund and META Grant)

Mr. Moody moved to approving in an amount not to exceed $161,826.00, seconded by Mr. Wolfe.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided a staff report. Chairman
Esquibel and all committee members commented on the item. Public comments were made by
Corey Loghry, Charles Miller, and Sophia Maes, Downtown Development Authority Executive
Director.

OTHER ITEMS FOR THE AGENDA:

       a)       Modification to Bid #E-4-25 for (3) Fire Apparatus for the City of Cheyenne,
                Cheyenne Fire Rescue Department. (General Fund Reserves and 2027-2030
                Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to approve with a savings of $44,035.06, seconded by Mr. Wolfe. Motion
carried by unanimous voice vote.

Chief Andrew Dykshom, Fire Rescue Department, provided a staff report and committee member
Moody commented on the item.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Finance Committee, the meeting
was adjourned at 1:52 p.m.
